    UI node

    The UI node is the visible screen state. It applies registered View commands on enter and exit, then waits for an output to choose the next route.

    Inspector

    Option Description
    Display Name Canvas title
    Node Description Authoring note
    Clear History Clears Back and Forward after entering
    Use Back Allows this active UI to request graph Back navigation
    On Enter UI Animated or Instant Show/Hide commands
    On Exit UI Commands merged while leaving
    Outputs Dynamic routes originating from this UI

    Output types

    Type Matching event
    Signal A matching NavButton, Signal.Send(...), or Custom Signal
    Time Delay Unscaled seconds since this UI became active
    Toggle A matching NavToggle value: On, Off, or Any
    UI View A matching Animated Show or Hide transition starts

    Signal outputs select Database or Custom addressing. Database uses the Signal catalog; Custom uses an ordinal, case-sensitive graph-local string.

    An output connects to exactly one target. Connect directly to another UI or Action chain, or connect several UI outputs to one Send Signal Multi input. There is no Destinations output on the UI node.

    Duplicate Signal addresses, duplicate View conditions, and overlapping Toggle conditions such as Any plus On are validation errors. UI View outputs fire at animation start; Instant View commands do not trigger them.
